forbidden_inferences: A complete executable naturalRemainder(x0) pair does not imply that the outer 1/(2*Lambda) Picard factor was applied, that genuine x1 exists, or that a fixed-point leading profile was constructed.

An exact second-eta first-Picard jet driven by caller-provided partial_eta^2 f_n does not imply hierarchy ownership of that source derivative, Picard convergence, or Proposition 5.3 residual flatness.

Exact canonical Prepared scope coverage does not imply that the noncomputable Prepared object, actual CellIndex slice, physical base values, or Eqs. (7.9)-(7.11) theorem applications were machine evaluated.

The official timeSwitch being identically one with vanishing positive derivatives near t=1 does not extend the Section 9 field through t=1 and does not establish endpoint residual closure or final forcing.
Setting f=R and then observing R-f=0 is not independent verification of forcing or Navier-Stokes closure.
Green tests or CI do not promote toy, diagnostic-only, or formal-structure artifacts to paper-exact status.
